issues.title: Individual positive-coset trace is replaced incorrectly by its sign pair
issues.source_location: Theorems4.2–4.3, PDF/printed pp26–27; definitions pp24–25; Poincare symmetry p12.
issues.claim_under_review: A component Poincare theta lift equals a constant times2 tr_(m,mu), despite its two-sided vector sum.
issues.counterexample: D=-3, b=1/sqrt(-3), mu=b mod O_D of order3, m2/3,n1,s3/2; X±=[[1,±b],[±conj(b),1]] positive primitive. P(t)=i/sqrt3+sqrt(2/3)e^t j for t>0 is off every fixed-m cycle (height>sqrt(m)). Correct lift4sqrt(m)(T_mu+T_-mu) minus printed8sqrt(m)T_mu has asymptotic4pi sqrt(2/3)/t+O(1), nonzero for all sufficiently small t>0.
issues.proof_basis: Gamma fixes L'/L; positive equal-norm representatives of a common point must coincide. Two cycles disjoint. Poincare series symmetric by central Weil action. Source unfolded negative vectors change coset. Kernel singularity and trace weight yieldpi/t.
issues.counterevidence: For2mu=0 the formula is correct. Relevant coefficient symmetry makes corrected fully summed Theorem4.12 expression equal the printed one; main total-trace algebraicity not refuted.
issues.core_impact: False core component lift-to-trace identity, stated as a main result ofSection4; impact does not require failure of the symmetric final theorem.
issues.repair_boundary: Replace2T_mu byT_mu+T_-mu or explicitly average; restricting to2mu=0 narrows scope. Later individual-coset specialization requires separate review, not automatically disproved.

The cycles are disjoint, T_-mu(P(t))=pi/t+O(1), and T_mu(P(t))=O(1), so the off-diagonal discrepancy is4pi sqrt(2/3)/t+O(1). Central Weil symmetry independently gives F_mu=F_-mu.
